title: Variable-Time-Step GRU for Transient Magnetic Hysteresis Modeling: implementation, released model weights, and archived hyperparameter-search logs
description:
Reproduction package for the manuscript Variable-Time-Step GRU for Transient Magnetic Hysteresis Modeling.

It contains the implementation of the fixed-update, time-step-scaled, and rate-update GRU models; the selected configuration of every reported experiment; twenty-one released checkpoints with SHA-256 checksums (eleven N87 models and one per-material model for each of ten soft ferrites); 228 sanitized per-run training logs documenting the reported hyperparameter searches; scripts that recompute every reported metric; and generators for all eleven manuscript figures.

Measurement data is not included. The experiments use the MagNetX transient hysteresis dataset (Kwon et al., IEEE APEC 2025, doi:10.1109/APEC48143.2025.10977252).
